offerings.name: Web search (all models)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 内置工具按 1k 调用计费
offerings.output_type: 模型内置工具；返回带 url_citation 内联引用的消息及 web_search_call
offerings.note: 支持 filters（最多100 allowed/blocked domains）、search_context_size low/medium/high、return_token_budget、user_location、图像结果；search context 128k；gpt-4o-mini/4.1-mini 非预览工具按每次固定 8000 input tokens 计费。

offerings.name: Image Web search (all models)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 内置工具按 1k 调用计费
offerings.note: 需设 search_content_types 含 image，用 image_settings 控制 max_results 与 caption；可通过 web_search_call.results 读取。

offerings.name: Web search preview (reasoning models, including `gpt-5`, `o-series`)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 内置工具按 1k 调用计费
offerings.note: legacy 工具；不支持 filters、return_token_budget、external_web_access 等新控制。

offerings.name: Web search preview (non-reasoning models)
offerings.pricing: $25.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens are free.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 内置工具按 1k 调用计费
offerings.note: search content tokens 免费，但单次调用价格更高。

offerings.name: gpt-5-search-api
offerings.pricing: Input $1.25 / Cached input $0.125 / Output $10.00 per 1M tokens
offerings.output_type: 搜索专用模型（Chat Completions，总是先搜索再回答）
offerings.note: 200k context；用于保留 Chat Completions 集成；不支持 domain filters、完整 source 列表、live-access control、returned-token budget。
